form.title: Faith Formation Registration
form.successTitle: Thank you. Your children are registered.
form.successBody: The Catechesis Coordinator will follow up about tuition and the class schedule. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.
step.getting-started.title: Getting started
step.getting-started.help: This takes about fifteen minutes. We save your progress as you go, so you can close this and come back.
step.getting-started.intent.label: What would you like to do?
step.getting-started.parish.label: Which parish?
If your family is new to the parish, please also fill out the parish registration form. This form enrolls your children in faith formation. It does not register your household with the parish.
step.getting-started.privacyNotice.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.
step.children.title: Children to enroll
step.children.help: Add one for each child you are enrolling. Tuition is charged per family, not per child.
step.children.children.label: Children
step.household.title: Where the children live
step.household.help: The parish office uses this address for mailings about the program.
step.household.check.contactMethods: Please give us at least one way to reach you: an email address or a phone number.
step.household.household.label: Home address
step.household.email.help: This is used for all communication about the program.
step.household.email.label: Email address
step.household.homePhone.label: Home phone
step.household.mobilePhone.label: Mobile phone

step.mother.title: Mother
step.mother.hasMother.label: Would you like to give the mother's details?
step.guardian.title: Custodial parent or guardian
step.guardian.help: Only if this is someone other than the parents above.
step.guardian.hasGuardian.label: Is the custodial parent or guardian different from the people above?
step.guardian.releaseNotice.html: Please note: we are unable to release a child to any person who is not listed as the custodial parent or guardian without written notification by the custodial parent or guardian. Parents are obligated to provide the Catechesis Coordinator or Office Administrator with custody or restraining legal documentation.
step.emergency.title: Emergency contacts
step.emergency.help: People we can call if we cannot reach you. Please give us at least one.
step.emergency.check.contactMethods: Please give us a phone number or email for your first emergency contact.
step.emergency.emergency1.label: First contact

step.tuition.title: Tuition
step.tuition.help: Tuition is charged per family. You can pay at the parish office or in the collection box.
step.tuition.tuitionTable.html:

step.tuition.hardshipNotice.html: Please tell the Catechesis Coordinator about any financial hardship. Tuition assistance is always available and no child is turned away.
